notes.title: 1.0.32 Hotfix
notes.notes:
BALANCE

- Perfect Defense is now easier to trigger.
- The damage animation for the second combo of the heavy punch is now longer.
- Fireball consumes fewer bars.
- Fire Sweep consumes fewer bars.
- Ultimates now grant more Special bars.

FIXES

- Fixed an issue where music and background audio would stop playing when using Fireball too frequently.
- Fixed an issue where Fire Feet Spin would occasionally stop moving forward.

notes.title: 1.0.25 Hotfix
notes.notes:
NEW

- Ultimate damage is now displayed in the Game Types menu.
- Specials and Ultimates that have the Retaliation Boost now show this in their descriptions.

BALANCE

- Retaliation Boost can now be triggered multiple times.
- When having 3 Specials, the number of enemies in Stage 1 has been reduced from 10 to 9.
- Ultimate damage has been increased.

FIXES

- Fixed an issue where Score drops wouldn’t spawn when killing some enemies at the edge of the stage.
- Fixed FireBall stopping in mid-air when missing a target at long distances.
- Fixed Critical Damage applying to attacks that don’t use fire.

notes.title: 1.0.21 Hotfix
notes.notes:
NEW

- Critical Damage now triggers a blue animation on the enemy's body to indicate that it has been activated.
- The Retaliation Boost description in the Gameplay Types menu is now clearer, specifying that it can only be activated by Specials and Ultimates.
- The Critical Damage description has been updated to clarify that the fire changes to blue when activated.

BALANCE

- When using 3 Specials, the purple-eyed enemy will appear starting from Stage 3, while the two-headed enemy begins appearing from Stage 1. The enemy count on screen remains increased from 8 to 10, instead of 10 to 12.
- The (Damage from basic attacks) improvement was reduced from 50% to 42%.
- The (Damage in Ultimate Attacks) improvement was increased from 25% to 80%.
- Increased the usage limit for improvements from 3 to 4.
- Increased Ultimate meter gain from punches.

FIXES

- Fixed an issue where pause menu options would not return to the last selected option.
- Fixed an issue where Retaliation Boost would trigger from basic fire combos with critical damage, instead of just Specials and Ultimates.
